sisi.depan: The far wall features a stationary train car with its side doors open to reveal a warmly lit interior, standing on tracks next to a tiled platform edge.
sisi.kanan: A large, dark arched metro tunnel opening dominates the right wall, which is covered in cracked ceramic tiles and has crates of supplies stacked against it.
sisi.belakang: The back wall contains a wide archway partially barricaded with stacked metal plates and old station benches, leaving a small gap for entry.
sisi.kiri: Along the left tiled wall stands a long workbench made from salvaged metal sheets, covered with disassembled electronic parts and tools.

tengah: Several unrolled sleeping bags and woven floor mats are arranged around a low table made from a large gear, all facing towards the front.
atas: A vaulted concrete ceiling has exposed conduits and thick cables from which hang numerous glowing cube-shaped lanterns constructed from colourful, patterned batik fabric panels stretched over wire frames.
